statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-114147 (GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm) is an ASP.NET Core denial of service: SignalR Redis scale-out can mishandle removal from a group whose name differs only in case, leaving subscriptions that allow persistent resource amplification. Microsoft fixed it in ASP.NET Core 10.0.15 and lists both the Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis package and the ASP.NET Core runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, from 10.0.0 through 10.0.14 as affected (https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/advisories/GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/509, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.15/10.0.15.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.24 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries; 10.0.15-r0 is built from the dotnet/dotnet v10.0.115 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v10.0.115). Scanned all 154 packages of the seven published builds (10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.12-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside their nupkg and tar.gz archives: every build ships Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Core.dll from its own .NET release, in the ASP.NET Core shared framework of aspnetcore10-runtime and in the SDK, runtime-pack nupkg and ASP.NET Core runtime archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and as a reference assembly in aspnetcore10-targeting-pack and in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref nupkg of dotnet10-runtime-artifacts; the earlier builds carry 10.0.8 through 10.0.14 and 10.0.15-r0 carries 10.0.15 on both architectures. No package of any build contains Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis, which applications restore from NuGet. The range ends at 10.0.15-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-114147 (GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm) is an ASP.NET Core vulnerability: SignalR Redis scale-out can mishandle a group removal whose case does not match and leave subscriptions behind, allowing persistent resource amplification and denial of service. Microsoft fixes it in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis package and in the ASP.NET Core runtime. Microsoft lists the ASP.NET Core 8.0 runtime, including the linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64 runtime packs, as affected up to 8.0.33 and fixed in 8.0.34 (https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/advisories/GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.34/8.0.34.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the ASP.NET Core shared framework at its own .NET version, in aspnetcore8-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap: 8.0.23 through 8.0.33 in the earlier builds and 8.0.34 in both 8.0.34-r0 builds. The range ends at 8.0.34-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-114147 (GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm) is an ASP.NET Core denial of service issue: SignalR Redis scale-out can mishandle case-mismatched group removal and leave subscriptions that permit persistent resource amplification; the fix changes the SignalR hub connection handling in the shared framework as well as the separate Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis package (https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/commit/cc53379f74963c4509ddfa91845132146d7054aa). Microsoft lists the ASP.NET Core 9.0 runtime, including the linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64 runtime packs, as affected up to 9.0.22 and fixed in 9.0.23 (https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/advisories/GHSA-wr8v-9x5q-ggcm, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/509, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.23/9.0.23.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries; 9.0.23-r0 is built from the dotnet/dotnet v9.0.124 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v9.0.124), and its assemblies record that tag's commit, f4699d9. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships ASP.NET Core 9 at its own .NET version in three places: the shared framework in aspnetcore9-runtime, the shared framework in the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap, and the ASP.NET Core runtime pack NuGet package that dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap also holds: 9.0.12 through 9.0.22 in the earlier builds and 9.0.23 in both 9.0.23-r0 builds, and each of those copies contains Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Core.dll. None of the packages contains Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis. The reference assemblies of the same name in aspnetcore9-targeting-pack, dotnet9-runtime-artifacts and the SDK's targeting pack are compile-time metadata with no implementation code. The range ends at 9.0.23-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
